OfficeSettings.title: OfficeSettings
OfficeSettings.description: Configuration object holding the visual and contact details of the dynamic license office.

officeName.description: The name of the licensing office.

officeAddress.description: Physical address of the licensing office.

officeLogo.description: An image URL or standard graphical visual placeholder for the logo.

contactNumber.description: Main public telephone contact for office inquiries.

websiteFooter.description: Custom disclaimer and copyright statement at the base of the pages.

homepageBanner.description: Text banner to showcase prominently on the public homepage.

searchMenuLabel.description: Custom visual label for the search menu tab.

requestMenuLabel.description: Custom visual label for the requests menu tab.

contactMenuLabel.description: Custom visual label for the contact menu tab.

noticesMenuLabel.description: Custom visual label for the notices menu tab.

consoleSecurityPin.description: Custom administrative PIN for console panel authorization.

License.title: License
License.description: A driving license ledger record containing applicant detail and current status.

fullName.description: Full name of the license holder.

licenseNumber.description: Unique identifier of the driving license.

department.description: Allocated department name or distribution section.

receivedBy.description: Name of citizen/representative who physically withdrew the license.

submittedDocs.description: List of selected submitted documents recorded during distribution.

submittedDocsOther.description: Specified value if Other was selected as a submitted document.

submittedDocsSavedBy.description: Email of user who saved the submitted documents details.

submittedDocsSavedDate.description: Date and time when the submitted documents were first saved.

submittedDocsUpdatedBy.description: Email of user who last updated the submitted documents details.

submittedDocsUpdatedDate.description: Date and time when the submitted documents were last updated.

submittedDocsResetBy.description: Email of user who reset the submitted documents and receiver details.

submittedDocsResetDate.description: Date and time when the submitted documents and receiver details were reset.

submittedDocsReceiverName.description: Specific name of the receiver recorded with the submitted documents.

recommendedStaffName.description: Full name of the office staff member who recommended the card distribution.

recommended_staff_name.description: Full name of the office staff member who recommended the card distribution (alternate field/snake_case).

updatedAt.description: Datetime tracking when the ledger was edited.

updatedBy.description: Staff email who committed the change.

logs.description: A list of tracking items detailing status alterations internally.

CollectionRequest.title: CollectionRequest
CollectionRequest.description: Form submission from users declaring scheduling of pick-ups.

licenseId.description: Pointer to the corresponding license record.

licenseHolderName.description: Applicant's name printed on the record.

receiverName.description: Declared name representing who is arriving.

Notice.title: Notice
Notice.description: An announcement text published to citizens inside search layout.

UserRole.title: UserRole
UserRole.description: A database record mapping specific user auth keys (usually emails or userIds) to operational authorization levels.

totalSearchesServed.description: Global atomic counter recording system searches (not empty).

UploadLedger.title: UploadLedger
UploadLedger.description: Bulk import session details and performance tracking statistics.

SecurityAuditLog.title: SecurityAuditLog
SecurityAuditLog.description: Log entry documenting critical database reset successes and failures.

/office_settings/{settingsId}.description: DynDoc storing configurations of office visual settings.

/licenses/{licenseId}.description: Primary repository containing prints driving licenses entries.

/collection_requests/{requestId}.description: Registrations submitted from the public to schedule licensed retrievals.

/notices/{noticeId}.description: Bulletins published by management for citizen viewing.

/users_roles/{roleId}.description: System list mapping registered credentials to operational roles (superuser, admin, staff).

/statistics/{statId}.description: Counter doc tracking searches and statistics globally.

/upload_ledgers/{ledgerId}/records/{reco.description: Backup of original license records attached to a specific upload lot.

/security_audit_logs/{logId}.description: Log records detailing database purge events.
